title: Analytics event repository
responsibility: Persists analytics events in a private SQLite store, reconciles historical project rows, and previews or applies timestamp-based retention.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.constructor.home
inputs.description: Directory that holds analytics.sqlite, created recursively (mode 0700) if missing. Defaults to process.env.HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME ?? join(homedir(), '.codex', 'harness'): the variable's value when it is set (even if empty), otherwise the .codex/harness directory under the home directory.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.constructor.options
inputs.description: Only 'deferred' skips schema setup in the constructor; any other value, including the default {}, creates the schema synchronously and retries the WAL switch up to 100 times with 25 ms sleeps. open passes 'deferred' so that setup runs asynchronously under its bounded retry loop instead.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.open.home
inputs.description: Directory that holds analytics.sqlite, created recursively (mode 0700) if missing. Defaults to process.env.HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME ?? join(homedir(), '.codex', 'harness'): the variable's value when it is set (even if empty), otherwise the .codex/harness directory under the home directory.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.reconcileHistorical.root
inputs.description: Directory whose canonical path is computed with realpath(), so a missing directory rejects with that filesystem error. The canonical path is compared with project; when they differ, historical rows whose stored project equals the canonical path are deleted.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.reconcileHistorical.project
inputs.description: Project identity compared with the canonical path of root; when they are equal, the call leaves the database untouched. When they differ, the deletion targets rows stored under the canonical path, so historical rows stored under this value are not removed by this call.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.record.event
inputs.description: Event to store: its id is the primary key, its timestamp is written to the timestamp column, and the whole event is saved as JSON in data. An id that is already stored, or any row that violates a NOT NULL or primary-key constraint, is skipped without raising an error.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.recordImported.event
inputs.description: Event upserted by id: its JSON replaces the stored data for that id, and when a stored row with that id has a historical flag that is not true, the passed object's historical is set to false before saving. The upsert updates only data, so the stored timestamp column keeps its original value.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.prune.before
inputs.description: Cutoff string that must parse as a Date, end in 'Z', have its first 19 characters equal to its normalized UTC form (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss), and be strictly earlier than the current time. Stored rows whose timestamp parses to an earlier time match; rows with unparseable timestamps are never matched or deleted.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.prune.apply
inputs.description: When true, matching rows are deleted in the same transaction that counts them; when false (the default), nothing is deleted, deleted is 0, and dryRun is true.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.open
outputs.description: Resolves to a repository with the schema in place, the database in WAL journal mode, and busy_timeout set to 5000 ms; busy or locked setup errors are retried with jittered backoff for up to five seconds before it resolves.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.reconcileHistorical
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after the historical-row DELETE runs, which happens only when realpath(root) differs from project; when they match, it resolves without touching the database.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.record
outputs.description: Returns nothing; the event is inserted with INSERT OR IGNORE, so an id that is already stored keeps its original row.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.recordImported
outputs.description: Returns nothing; the event is upserted by id, and when a stored row with that id is not historical, the saved event has historical set to false.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.events
outputs.description: Returns every stored event parsed from its data JSON, ordered by the stored timestamp column and then by rowid.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.prune
outputs.type: { before: string; matching: number; deleted: number; dryRun: boolean }
outputs.description: Reports before as the normalized toISOString() cutoff, matching as the count of rows with an earlier parseable timestamp, deleted as the rows removed (0 unless apply is true), and dryRun as true unless apply is true.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.close
outputs.description: Returns nothing; it closes the underlying SQLite database handle.

errors.name: Unsupported analytics schema version
errors.description: Thrown by the synchronous constructor, or rejected by open, when PRAGMA user_version is greater than 1; the connection is closed before the error propagates.

errors.name: Analytics storage failure
errors.description: Filesystem failures from mkdir, chmod, and realpath, plus SQLite open, PRAGMA, query, and close failures, are rethrown unchanged to the caller.

errors.name: Invalid retention cutoff
errors.description: Thrown by prune before any query runs unless before parses as a Date, ends in 'Z', has its first 19 characters equal to its normalized UTC form, and is strictly earlier than now.
examples: Retention cutoff must be an ISO UTC timestamp in the past.

errors.name: Analytics initialization timeout
errors.description: open rejects with this error after about five seconds of busy or locked SQLite errors during setup, attaches the last SQLite error as cause, and closes the connection first.
examples: Timed out waiting to initialize the analytics database.

errors.name: UnsupportedAnalyticsSchemaVersionError
errors.description: Thrown by the schema-version check that the synchronous constructor and open run, with the message 'Unsupported analytics schema version.'

errors.name: InvalidRetentionCutoffError
errors.description: Thrown by the retention-cutoff check in prune, with the message 'Retention cutoff must be an ISO UTC timestamp in the past.'

errors.name: AnalyticsInitializationTimeoutError
errors.description: Thrown by the initialization timeout in open, with the message 'Timed out waiting to initialize the analytics database.'

errors.description: An InvalidRetentionCutoffError thrown by prune before any query runs when before does not parse as a Date, does not end in 'Z', has a first 19 characters that differ from its normalized UTC form, or is not strictly earlier than now. Its message is 'Retention cutoff must be an ISO UTC timestamp in the past.'

errors.name: Analytics storage failure
